platforms.language: Rwanda: 13 of 51 captions in Kinyarwanda, most English, French on 1. Property and cheap-goods ads lean Kinyarwanda; hotels, clinics, tech and beauty lean English. Tanzania: Swahili. Kenya and Uganda: English. Numbers as people write them (38,000 RWF, 48K, 400K, 350M RWF).
findings: Of 51 Rwandan video ads: 22 use a 'Send WhatsApp message' button, 13 send to an Instagram profile, 4 'Call now'; 1 website sign-up, 1 booking site.
35 of 51 put the phone number in the caption.
Addresses are landmarks, not streets: 'Next to DELIGHT HOTEL', 'opposite IPRC traffic lights', 'Makuza Peace Plaza, Room 35', 'same building as boho, door 8'.
13 of 51 captions are in Kinyarwanda; most are English; 1 is French. Cleopatra Home writes the caption twice, English then Kinyarwanda.
Median video length 34 s; about half under 30 s (under 20 s for products and offers, 40 to 90 s with a talking person).
The caption carries the spec list (checklist emojis: price, size, area, water and power, title, delivery); the video is the proof, the caption is the contract.

findings: Median 15 s, range 8 to 51 s; 23 of 36 are 15 s or shorter; the most-liked (32K, 27K, 9.3K) are 10 s.
None of the 36 says or writes 'subscribe': YouTube draws its own Subscribe button.
Shorts have no ad button: the ad is a pointer (a number, a QR code, a name to search).
Local shop Shorts put the phone number in the title.

tradeRoutes.when: The default in Rwanda: 22 of 51 Rwandan Facebook video ads use the 'Send WhatsApp message' button, and 35 of 51 put the number in the caption.
13 of 51 Rwandan Facebook ads send people to the Instagram profile; still give the number.
Services, car hire, travel, restaurants taking orders by phone ('Call now' on 4 of 51).
Kigali restaurants that deliver through the VubaVuba app (only when the owner says so).
Walk-in shops, clinics, bars and restaurants: a landmark, not a street ('Next to DELIGHT HOTEL', 'opposite IPRC traffic lights', 'Makuza Peace Plaza, Room 35').
Cash-on-delivery sellers; the trust line. Only when the owner offers both.
None of 51 Rwandan Facebook ads mentions MoMo: an opening. Only when the owner accepts MoMo.
YouTube Shorts have no ad button: end on a QR code, the number or the name to search.
